items.title: Ferrand Clementin Interview, 1973-08-02
items.q: The interviewee does not speak in the provided context; the mention of 'Bebe' (Thomas Mitchell) is made solely by the interviewer.

ctx.x: Mitchell was his last name. You don't know his first name. He was called by the His name was I think Albert. His name was Albert.
I used to know it. Thomas Mitchell, they called him Bebe. Yeah, he played the bass. But it's probably a different family.

I kind of forgot it. You can't remember all those people I know. No, some other than they all been big. One was Peter Mitchell. Peter Mitchell was the man that taught them. He taught them. He taught them. He taught them. He taught them. And he had two songs listening.
